status: Frozen prospective-analysis specification for retrospective, previously unanalyzed games; not external preregistration
selection: First 24 valid NBA moneyline games in chronological scheduled-tip order, breaking ties by slug; no volume, price-movement, or social-activity thresholds
no_replacements: Record collection/coverage exclusions; never replace a game based on forecasts or post counts
training: Fit only on the original eight games. No retraining, hyperparameter tuning, or feature selection using test outcomes.
primary_price: Next-minute signed home-team log-odds change; original B0 and B1 versus B1 plus all original social features
secondary_activity: Next-five-minute log(1+USDC volume); persistence, market baseline, and baseline plus all original social features
sensitivity_checks: exclude posts not indexed by end of their original minute
target_alignment: Features through end of minute t; future targets t+1..t+h, all inside actual game-time window
price_definition: End-of-minute last trade, then CLOB fallback, then flagged forward fill; logit clipped to [0.01,0.99]
window: Scheduled tip minus 120 minutes through plus 210 minutes; exclude from primary test if actual ESPN final lies outside the collected window
primary_metric: Pooled held-out RMSE; also report equal-game RMSE, MAE, and per-game errors
uncertainty: Whole-game bootstrap and per-game paired losses; account for repeated teams/date clusters in interpretation; no minute-independence claims
claim_limit: Predictive associations, not causal effects or proof of universal market efficiency. No guaranteed positive result.
data_quality: Outcome-blind relevance/novelty review remains required for content-quality claims; preserve original broad-keyword features for the unchanged comparison.
